propositions: Complete end-to-end test suite must cover mixed success, transient recovery, long-delay deferral, permanent failure, auth/provider stop, fuse open/reset, label-first create, restart, partial outcome, and delivery failure scenarios without external credentials.
Route census and runtime poison checks must verify that no removed production path remains reachable in the coordinator and adapter implementation.
ADR 0103 must be finalized documenting retry ownership, failure taxonomy, fuse behavior, containment strategy, intentional deltas, expand/contract cutover, and rollback guarantees.
Architecture and operator documentation must define planner-to-coordinator-to-adapter dependency direction, versioned output contract, and future adapter atomic-operation and retry obligations.
Rollback behavior must re-observe remote state and guarantee no successful Jira work is deleted during contract removal or recovery operations.
